title: Where does the document pipeline saturate?
description: Change arrival work, OCR routing, parser workers, and review staffing. The model shows which queue grows first and why parser and human capacity must be planned together.

workloads.label: Digital forms
workloads.detail: Mostly native text with stable fields and limited OCR fallback.

workloads.detail: OCR-heavy pages with tables, normalization, and financial review gates.

workloads.label: Mixed document packets
workloads.detail: Digital pages, scans, tables, and attachments share one ingestion stream.
